imageChanges: Added multi-stage production-dependencies target running 'npm ci --omit=dev' to isolate runtime dependencies from build/test harnesses.

Hardened runner stage: /app/node_modules now receives strictly production dependencies from production-dependencies stage, completely eliminating vitest, tinypool, eslint, prettier, and playwright test frameworks from the runtime container.
Preserved native binary support for Sharp (0.35.5) with musl libc prebuilds for Alpine Linux, verified with live PNG generation in container.
Traced Next.js standalone output (.next/standalone, .next/static, public) remains primary web server boundary with zero dev tooling loaded.
Moved tsx to production dependencies to ensure background worker and operational CLIs run predictably in production container without devDependencies.
